question:
Identify the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Scary
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Scary"** means something that causes fear or is frightening. (डरावना)

 
 
• **Example:** The haunted house was so scary that many people refused to enter.
 
 
 
• **"Comforting"** refers to something that provides a sense of relief or reassurance, making one feel relaxed and safe. (सांत्वना देने वाला)
 
 
• **Example:** The mother's comforting words helped calm the frightened child.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'scary'** is **'comforting'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Bright **(उज्ज्वल): Emitting or reflecting a lot of light; shining.

 
 
• **Example:** The bright sunlight made it hard to see.
 
 
 
• **Pristine **(अप्रदूषित): In its original condition; unspoiled.
 
 
• **Example:** The beach was pristine, with clear water and clean sand.
 
 
 
• **Awful **(भयानक): Very bad or unpleasant.
 
 
• **Example:** The food at the restaurant was awful.
